note: One Piece bounties, oldest first ("luffy bounty", "zoro wanted poster"). Each amount from two sources; chapter and episode of the reveal only where two sources agree. Only the first is shown without a spoiler toggle.

entries.why: His first bounty, for beating Buggy, Don Krieg and Arlong: the highest in the East Blue, and the poster that makes him known as Straw Hat Luffy.
For defeating Crocodile, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.
For the attack on the World Government's judicial island to rescue Robin, where he beats Rob Lucci of CP9.
For punching a World Noble at Sabaody, breaking into Impel Down and joining the war at Marineford; shown when the story resumes after the two-year timeskip.
For defeating Doflamingo, another of the Seven Warlords.
For beating two of Big Mom's Sweet Commanders, Cracker and Katakuri, and escaping her territory. Luffy first misreads it as 150 million.
For defeating Kaido. He is named one of the Four Emperors, and Law and Kid get the same bounty.
